title: Khung chuyển động vẽ tay — sinh vật Aquarium + chim mây
note: Decision 050 (5), mở rộng cho Aquarium và Cloud (chủ dự án chọn mọi sinh vật nước + chim mây). Mỗi sheet = MỘT sinh vật, 4 ô: (1) tranh đã duyệt vẽ lại để đo cỡ (không dùng), (2)(3)(4) ba khung chuyển động, chạy 1 → 2 → 3 → 2. Ảnh 2 = tranh đã duyệt. Nên render thử vài sheet trước (gợi ý: A01 Cá Vàng, A11 Cá Trăng, A23 Sứa, A26 Đuối, C1 Chim mây), agent kiểm rồi mới làm hết. Lưu kết quả A01.png … A28.png, C1.png trong thư mục này.

sheets.title: Cá Vàng (fish_goldfish): bơi (tail)

refs.subject: this exact creature (Cá Vàng) as it is approved in my game
the layout of the four cells and the tail positions: one creature per cell, same size, cell 1 as in image 2, cells 2 to 4 the three moving frames in this order

rows: IDLE — exactly as in image 2
SWIM frame 1 — swimming: the tail fin swept UP in a soft curve, the back half of the body gently curved, the side fin folded back
SWIM frame 2 — swimming: the body straight, the tail fin straight and spread wide, the side fin open (the middle of the stroke)
SWIM frame 3 — swimming: the tail fin swept DOWN in a soft curve, the back half of the body gently curved the other way, the side fin pushed forward
extra: All four cells show the SAME single creature: Cá Vàng, the creature shown in image 2. Keep it IDENTICAL to image 2: the same colours, markings, outline, fin shapes, fin colours, eye and body proportions, drawn at the SAME scale as in image 2.

Cells 2, 3 and 4 are the three in-between frames of ONE swimming cycle, played 2 → 3 → 4 → 3 in a loop: the creature stays in the SAME place, at the SAME size, with the SAME face as image 2 in all of them; ONLY the tail fin, the back half of the body and the small fins change from cell to cell. EVERY cell faces the SAME way as image 2.
sheets.framing: A character animation sheet: each cell holds the whole creature once, at the SAME size in every cell, in the middle of the cell, about 70 % of the cell height (or width) with all its fins and tail fully inside the cell.
